subject: Staged onramp & sign-off plan — MSA/DPA/order form for HealthNova pilot
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Chris Lang <chris.lang@healthnova.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Staged onramp & sign-off plan — MSA/DPA/order form for HealthNova pilot

Hi Chris —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. To keep momentum for the HealthNova pilot, I sketched a staged onramp and sign-off plan that aligns procurement gating with our mutual action plan (MAP). Attaching a short MAP (HN_proposed_MAP_v1.xlsx) — high level below: 

1) Evaluation (2 weeks): pilot integration, baseline eval prompts, telemetry capture.
2) Security/compliance review (3 business days after request): SOC 2 + questionnaire response.
3) Contracting — MSA redlines (target: 3 business days internal review) + DPA acceptance (target: 5 business days once DPA template received).
4) Order form + PO: order form prepared by Redwood; HealthNova issues PO for first month to trigger provisioning.
5) Pilot start: provisioning + onboarding runbook handed over.

Asks / open items for you:
- Who's the procurement contact we should loop in for PO timing?
- Any must-have legal terms (data residency, export controls, required SLA)?
- Are you able to sign a redline MSA and DPA on the timeline above if we share redlines immediately?

If that looks ok, I’ll loop in our contracts and legal (cc’ing them here) and push the MSA/DPA templates today so procurement can start their internal review. Goal: keep the commercial close within a two-week window from signature readiness.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: HN_proposed_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet — pilot milestones & acceptance criteria)

From: Chris Lang <chris.lang@healthnova.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@healthnova.com>, procurement@healthnova.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged onramp & sign-off plan — MSA/DPA/order form for HealthNova pilot

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear plan. High level we like the staged approach but two constraints from procurement/legal:

- Procurement requires vendor W-9 and our standard vendor setup form before they issue a PO.
- Legal flagged data residency and subprocessor disclosure — those are likely redlines for our DPA.
- Our procurement lead (Tara Singh) needs at least 5 business days to process a PO once the vendor is onboarded.

If Redwood can provide the MSA with proposed redlines and a DPA template by EOD tomorrow, procurement will start the vendor setup and aim to issue an initial PO for the one-month pilot by end of next week. We can accept a staged acceptance gating that ties invoicing to milestone sign-offs (helps our finance team).

Cc’ing Tara here to confirm timeline.

—Chris

Director, Product & Integrations — HealthNova
chris.lang@healthnova.com

Subject: Fwd: Staged onramp & sign-off plan — MSA/DPA/order form for HealthNova pilot

Marissa / Karthik —

Forwarding HealthNova notes. Quick summary of asks:
- They need W-9 and vendor setup (procurement).
- DPA will likely be redlined for data residency + full subprocessor disclosure.
- Procurement needs ~5 business days to issue PO after onboarding.

Can legal turn around a lightweight redline of our MSA (highlighting any clauses that could block a pilot) by tomorrow EOD? If we can pre-send a DPA template that accepts a limited residency scope and full subprocessor appendix, procurement might complete set-up faster.

Karthik — can contracts draft a simple order form for a one-month pilot (SKU, seat estimate, billing cadence, SLA targets, termination for convenience) so they can preview before issuing PO? If we align order form + milestone invoicing, it should satisfy their finance gating.

Proposed internal actions (short):
- Marissa: MSA redlines + DPA template — EOD tomorrow.
- Karthik: Draft order form + brief invoice milestone language — tomorrow morning.
- Kimberly: provide W-9 + vendor onboarding contact to HealthNova right away.

I’ll attach the MAP we shared and follow up with an internal sync if needed.

Thanks —
Kim

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Lang <chris.lang@healthnova.com>, Tara Singh <tara@healthnova.com>, procurement@healthnova.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged onramp & sign-off plan — MSA/DPA/order form for HealthNova pilot

Kimberly / Karthik / Chris —

I reviewed the ask and can do the following:

1) MSA: I will circulate a redline (Redwood_MSA_v3_redlines.pdf) that preserves standard service terms but flags three likely negotiation points: data residency (we can offer a limited residency commitment for the pilot, but production residency needs account-level agreement), indemnity caps (we should keep standard caps), and audit frequency (propose quarterly info only for pilot).

2) DPA: I will send a concise DPA template (Redwood_DPA_template.docx) that contains a subprocessor appendix placeholder. For the pilot we can agree to provide the current subprocessor list and commit to notify of changes. HealthNova should confirm whether they need a specific EU data-export clause; if so, we can add language but it adds a day or two.

3) Invoice / order form gating: I endorse a milestone-based invoicing approach for the pilot (50% on provisioning, 50% on acceptance checkpoint). That will help HealthNova’s finance team sign off before full production terms are negotiated. Karthik — please include brief milestone language in the order form.

Deliverables & timing:
- Today EOD PST: MSA redline pdf + DPA template docx.
- Karthik to attach order form draft tomorrow morning.

If HealthNova can confirm they will accept a limited residency pilot and milestone invoices, we can keep to the compressed two-week commercial close.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3_redlines.pdf, Redwood_DPA_template.docx

From: Chris Lang <chris.lang@healthnova.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@healthnova.com>, procurement@healthnova.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged onramp & sign-off plan — MSA/DPA/order form for HealthNova pilot

Thanks everyone — this looks workable. Two quick confirmations: 

1) HealthNova can accept a limited residency commitment for the pilot (we will scope production residency in the next phase).
2) We will accept milestone invoicing (50/50) as long as the order form includes explicit acceptance criteria for the second milestone.

Tara (procurement) will kick off vendor setup as soon as you send W-9 and the MSA redline / DPA template. If you can also post the DocuSign packet link, we’ll route signature through our legal intake and aim to issue the PO by Friday next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to jump on a 20-minute sync if needed.

—Chris

Attachment: DocuSign packet (link posted)
